description: This file provides localization strings and functions for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1 for the Serbian language, including messages for errors, input validation, and other UI prompts.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the error message when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has entered too many characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has entered too few characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable items has been reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a search is in progress.
